source: Direct author direction: extremely rare giant megafauna form difficult great hunts, with higher-value and higher-rarity biological harvests. Specific item anatomy and uses are new local brainstorming proposals.
boundary: Catalog-only brainstorming. Ordinary shells remain cheap bulk; no generic meat/fat, general edibility, cloth, wood, natural free water, defined yields, recipes or implemented harvesting introduced. No external lore retrieval or source-canon claims.
worldIntegration: World identity, terrain/chunk streaming, unload/reload, generated object identity and persisted runtime deltas do not apply: no Unity world objects or live saves are created or edited. Authored constraints remain in WORLD_BASIS; stable catalog item IDs identify the new proposals.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Physical hunt cargo; compatible packing, containment, mass and handling remain unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Select and preserve the anatomical specimen for later qualification. No recipe, usable yield or operating performance established.
defaults.Limitations: Potentially toxic or contaminated biological cargo. No edibility, human filtration, medical use, rated protection, live-organ function or stored usable energy is established.
defaults.Classification basis: Author-requested great-hunt biological material brainstorm. Specific anatomy and receiving designs remain proposals.
